source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: EndMsgDownload applies the accumulated counts per destination URI, skips folders that no longer exist, and avoids setting new-mail state on Junk. It adds to existing destination new counts and sets HasNewMessages and BiffState_NewMail when the total is positive, then clears and releases the map. IMAP/coalesced moves use a different route. Current EndMsgDownload returns NS_OK, unlike the historical shared rv; do not infer its final return from the old diff.
title: Publish destination new-mail counts at the POP3 batch boundary
